entries.note: The order's registration. The tracker writes its spaces as question marks, which the shared cleaning turns back into spaces.
The parcel leaves the Shenzhen operations centre.

entries.wording: Out of warehouse, waiting for matching flight
entries.note: The platform's custom track row: the parcel has left the warehouse and waits for a flight. Listed as a planned step.
Names the booked flight's departure day, read as an ellipsis, before the take-off. A forecast, not a movement, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.wording: The flight has landed and will be handed over to the warehouse after customs clearance
entries.note: The flight lands in Europe; import clearance follows.

entries.wording: Import customs clearance completed awaiting extraction
entries.note: Import clearance done; the parcel waits to be collected from the airport.

entries.wording: Sent to warehouse, waiting for scanning
entries.note: The parcel reaches the delivery carrier's depot and waits for its first scan there.

entries.wording: Shipment not yet received or processed
entries.note: GOFO's label row, copied on GOFO's wall clock: the delivery carrier holds the parcel's data, not the parcel.

entries.wording: The instruction data for this shipment have been provided by the sender to DHL electronically
entries.note: DHL's label row, copied on DHL's wall clock with the tracker's status glued to its end, which is dropped.

entries.wording: A preferred neighbour was designated as a reception option for this shipment.
entries.note: DHL's row for the recipient's choice of a neighbour, copied. A delivery preference, not a movement, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.wording: The shipment is in transit to DHL
entries.note: DHL's row, copied: the parcel is on its way to DHL.
